faqs.question: Do I need to be fit before starting?
Do you offer online coaching?
faqs.answer: Yes. Online coaching is available and can include training, nutrition, check-ins and accountability.

faqs.question: Do I need a gym?
faqs.answer: No, but it helps. The plan can be built around your equipment, gym access and current ability.

faqs.question: Will I have to eat boring food?
faqs.answer: No. Boring diets die quickly. We build structure that works in the real world.

services.title: 1-to-1 Personal Training
services.text: Private one-to-one coaching designed to help you lose fat, build strength, and move with confidence. Every session is tailored to your body, your goals, and your current level, all delivered in a private gym setting with no gym membership required.

services.title: Personalised Workout Plan
services.text: A custom workout plan delivered through my app, designed to help you train with structure, purpose, and progression. You’ll track your sessions, follow the plan independently, and receive a weekly check-in so your programme can be updated as you improve. Ideal if you only need expert training structure without nutrition or daily support

services.title: Meal-by-Meal Nutrition Coaching
services.text: Designed for people who already train but need help getting their nutrition under control. You’ll send your meals for review, and I’ll guide you meal by meal to improve your food choices, portions, protein intake, calories, supplements, and overall consistency. This option includes nutrition support only, with no training plan or WhatsApp support.

services.title: Complete Transformation Coaching
services.text: For clients who need more than just a plan. This package includes a personalised workout programme that evolves as you get stronger, full meal-by-meal nutrition coaching, supplement guidance, habit building, and ongoing WhatsApp support. We’ll work together to build the discipline, confidence, mindset, and structure needed to lose fat, build strength, overcome setbacks, and create lasting change.
